title: The same AI request emits 8.5 times more CO2 in Texas than in Sweden
hook_text: Eight point five times more CO2
script:
Eight point five times more CO2. That is what the exact same AI request emits in Texas compared to Sweden.
Berget analyzed carbon intensity differences across regional data center grids.
Data centers draw power constantly from local electrical grids.
Grid carbon intensity dictates the exact footprint of your prompt.
Where you send a prompt changes its environmental impact.
Would you route your queries to cleaner regions?
